cover_letter_text:
Hi Core-EP team,

I'm Marc Masarate. I graduated in February 2026 with an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, and I'd like to start out as a junior drafter. Your role reports to a Senior Drafter and works with your engineers and scientists, and that's the kind of start I'm after.

My diploma work was road, earthworks and stormwater drainage design, all drawn up in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. Before that, on site in the Philippines, I reviewed drawings, checked the work against them and kept the material records.

I live in Melton with my own transport, can start two weeks after an offer, and have full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa). I'd be glad to come in and talk.

Kind regards,
Marc Masarate
